environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in private subnet. The order-consumer service polls SQS and forwards processed orders to an internal admin API running on a separate ECS service at http://admin-api.internal:8080. The admin API is accessible via a private ALB with no authentication requirements on the listener - any traffic from the VPC is accepted. The admin API endpoint parses the JSON payload and the 'action' field is interpolated into a shell command for legacy fulfillment system integration (e.g., action='ship' becomes '/opt/fulfill.sh ship <order_id>'). SQS queue has no message filtering or content validation policies.

config.admin_api_alb: Internal ALB, HTTP listener on port 80, no auth, forwards to target group
config.sqs_policy: Allow SendMessage from any authenticated AWS principal in account
config.admin_api_backend: Interpolates action field into shell command without additional sanitization
